name: Donova Snowden
summary: Beside Frostfire Hot Springs, Donova Snowden studies Winterspring’s strange warmth and the Winterfall furbolgs’ growing corruption. She camps in the bitter cold, far from most travelers in Everlook.

sections.title: A Lone Researcher in the Snow
sections.body: Donova Snowden camps in the frozen wilds near Frostfire Hot Springs, while most travelers stay in Everlook. She studies heat rising through the permafrost and dark influences spreading among Winterspring’s native wildlife. Practical and determined, she calls on passing adventurers from both the Alliance and the Horde to gather samples and help curb local threats.

sections.title: Investigating the Winterfall
sections.body: Donova Snowden studies the Winterfall furbolgs, whose behavior has grown erratic and aggressive. She examines potent brews such as Winterfall Firewater and strange toxins circulating among the tribes, seeking the cause of their sudden madness. Her fieldwork makes her a key contact for anyone trying to understand the corruption spreading through the northern mountains.

faq.q: Where can I find Donova Snowden?
faq.answer: Donova Snowden camps beside a small hot spring southwest of Frostfire Hot Springs, across the main road, in Winterspring.

faq.q: Why is Donova out here in the freezing cold?
faq.answer: Donova Snowden studies Winterspring’s unusual hot springs and investigates the corruption affecting the local Winterfall furbolg tribe.

faq.q: Will Donova work with Horde players?
faq.answer: Yes. Though she is a dwarf, Donova Snowden works independently and offers work to Alliance and Horde adventurers alike.

faq.q: What is Donova investigating regarding the Winterfall furbolgs?
faq.answer: Donova Snowden studies the corruption driving the Winterfall tribe to madness. She investigates their strange brews, including Winterfall Firewater, and the foul toxins found among their runners.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you may recognize the urge to brave frozen peaks alone. Donova Snowden’s fieldwork recalls the dwarven appetite for exploration far from Khaz Modan.

As a member of the Horde, you can work with Donova Snowden despite her dwarven heritage. She sets faction allegiance aside to recruit capable scouts against Winterspring’s wild beasts and corrupted furbolgs.
